evidence.quote: We propose a $36 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s records, plus $6 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Our opening term sheet reflects the size of the disputed charges while accounting for litigation risk. Fees remain subject to court approval

evidence.agent: Whitcombe Reyes LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: Fees were included in the proposals from the first round; they were not first discussed after class relief was agreed.

summary: Class counsel included fee requests in their opening proposals, before any class relief was finally agreed, so fees were raised first by plaintiffs and negotiated before settlement of the class fund. The transcript does not show any explicit tradeoff of fees for reduced class relief, plaintiff self-interest, defense leverage of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
